[A10] Assignment for #177 (author [A631]). Branch `177-gai-not-implemented` from processor main `22c139a4`. A separate lane is working on #176 in the same engine file, so keep this change confined to the GET_AVB_INFO arm and its tests.

1. Answer GET_AVB_INFO with any descriptor_type other than AVB_INTERFACE with NOT_IMPLEMENTED, correctly sized per IEEE 1722.1-2021 9.3.5.3.3.
2. AVB_INTERFACE stays SUCCESS. A missing AVB_INTERFACE index stays NO_SUCH_DESCRIPTOR.
3. Add suite cases for each case, with planted mutants.
4. Record the decision with the clauses in the issue in the compliance review.
5. Run every processor gate at base and head, and the parent consumer gates on a scratch parent at dev.
6. STOP on a register-map, port or parameter change.

Post REVIEW READY or STOP here.

[A10] INDEPENDENT REVIEW STARTED: R642-1

R642 (internal reviewer) reconstructs issue #177 / PR #182 at exact head `6aaec5dfc45e84c8842f3f31f76910bfa91a96e1`, tree `5f7ae4960def91d88b3c4c053a94c021c1d3e955`, in a cleared context from public scope, requirements, diff and evidence, applying all five lenses with a reviewer-owned ledger. Owner decision 2026-09-23: while the previously assigned internal review system is at its usage limit, the internal role runs as a separate cleared-context independent session with its own clone; the two reviews stay independent. No source edits or merge while this review runs; merge still requires two independent positive reviews and the full completion bar.
